svg.title: Index Translator architecture
svg.desc: The web app runs in the browser. It picks the model by the text's length and keeps the history, any opened PDF and any recording's player there. Its requests go to one Bun process. A translation waits in its own line for the llama worker thread, which loads the chat model; the same thread translates the text in an image. Reading aloud and transcribing a recording share a second line for the speech worker thread, which loads the speech model, the voice separator and the transcription models. Sentence ends and paragraph matching go to a third worker on the CPU, and a web page is opened in a headless browser. The workers never wait for each other. a translation: Web app → HTTP API → Translation line → llama worker. reading aloud or transcribing: Web app → HTTP API → Speech line → speech worker. sentence ends: Web app → HTTP API → segment worker.

g.text: one at a time, also transcribing
